1. Definitions

"Service" means the Example platform, including the website, the API and the mobile applications.
The Service includes every feature we make available now or in the future, whether free or paid.

2. Subscriptions and billing

2.1 Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each billing period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date. We may change subscription prices at any time; changes take effect at your next billing period after 30 days' notice by email.

2.2 If you cancel an annual plan before the end of the term, a cancellation fee equal to two months of service applies. Refunds are not provided for partial billing periods.

  1. Payment is due in full at the start of each billing period. We accept the payment methods listed at checkout.
    1. Failed payments are retried three times over ten days before the account is suspended.
    2. A suspended account keeps its data for 90 days, after which it is permanently deleted.
  2. Taxes are calculated at checkout based on the billing address you provide and are added to the listed price.
